verdicts.reason: A has a sensible banner layout: a large red headline and info stack on the left and the art on the right, with good hierarchy. Its flaws: the white frame sits off-centre inside the image instead of breaking its edge as in the original, the two black rules float with a big gap above the headline, and there is a stray tick mark above 'ART'. B is worse: the black rules and a tick mark cut across the dot artwork, the white frame is gone, and the headline and info are small and pushed into a cramped column on the right. B also leaves stray vertical line fragments at the bottom and empty white space on the right.
